No mechanism in signal_runner.py currently pulls the fire earlier when a break-and-retest condition was already satisfiable N bars sooner. Feature to compute per book candidate: re-scan the signal bar's preceding window for the earliest bar at which the same break-and-retest / one-candle-rule condition already held (same level, same direction), and measure the offset in bars/minutes between that bar and the bar the engine actually fired on. Distribution of that offset across the 2-year book is the thing to report; a selection/earlier-fire arm keyed on it is the testable predicate.
